entries.heading: REPEAL OF AUTHORITY TO LEASE SUBSTANDARD FAMILY HOUSING UNITS TO MEMBERS OF THE UNIFORMED SERVICES
entries.text:
SEC. 2812. REPEAL OF AUTHORITY TO LEASE SUBSTANDARD FAMILY HOUSING 
                          UNITS TO MEMBERS OF THE UNIFORMED 
                          SERVICES.

    (a) Repeal.--Section 2830 of title 10, 
United States Code, is repealed.

[[Page 134 STAT. 4327]]

    (b) Clerical Amendment.--The table of sections at the beginning of 
subchapter II of chapter 169 of title 10, United States Code, is 
amended by striking the item relating to 
section 2830.
